commands.command:
set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/selective-tape-restore
id
sudo -n true
printf 'sudo-noninteractive=yes\n'
printf '%s\n' '--- requested archive members ---'
tar -tvf "$base/tapes/friday.tar" -T "$base/restore-request.txt"
printf '%s\n' '--- validate request paths ---'
while IFS= read -r item; do
  case "$item" in
    invoices/INV-[0-9][0-9][0-9].txt) ;;
    *) printf 'unsafe-or-unexpected request path: %s\n' "$item" >&2; exit 1 ;;
  esac
  [ "$(tar -tf "$base/tapes/friday.tar" "$item" | wc -l)" -eq 1 ]
  printf 'validated %s\n' "$item"
done < "$base/restore-request.txt"

commands.command:
set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/selective-tape-restore
archive="$base/tapes/friday.tar"
live="$base/live"
printf '%s\n' '--- live tree after restore ---'
find "$live" -printf '%y %m %U:%G %s %P\n' | sort
printf '%s\n' '--- requested files: byte comparison and modes ---'
while IFS= read -r item; do
  tar -xOf "$archive" "$item" | cmp - "$live/$item"
  printf 'archive-bytes-match=yes mode='; stat -c '%a size=%s path=%n' "$live/$item"
  sha256sum "$live/$item"
done < "$base/restore-request.txt"
printf '%s\n' '--- protected and unrelated-file checks ---'
echo '0f060a93ce03b8a38e00181862fc775d127160011235f60f4d040afd98e84d51  '"$live/customers.csv" | sha256sum -c -
test ! -e "$live/old-notes.txt"
[ "$(find "$live" -type f | wc -l)" -eq 3 ]
printf 'customers-preserved=yes old-notes-restored=no live-file-count=3\n'
printf '%s\n' '--- pre-restart boot and health ---'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
findmnt -no TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS /
uname -r
printf 'data-health=healthy\n'
